announcements.headline: Restoration - PACSCo Limited
announcements.insight: Shares are suspended following a strategic review and asset disposal. The restoration announcement signals potential resumption of trading after this period of uncertainty.

announcements.headline: Suspension - PACSCo Limited
announcements.insight: PACS shares are suspended following the completion of a disposal and subsequent strategic review. Shareholders should monitor for further updates on the company's future direction.

announcements.headline: 2026 Annual Accounts Timetable

announcements.headline: Update on Company's Future Strategy
announcements.insight: This strategic update follows the Mozambique asset disposal announced in July 2026. Shareholders should watch for details on how this sale influences future direction.

announcements.headline: Update on Mozambique Asset Disposal
